ar: قُلْ هُوَ اللّٰهُ أَحَدٌۚ ۝۱ اَللّٰهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝۲ لَمْ يَلِدْۙ ۵ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ ۝۳ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهٗ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ۝۴ ـ سَبْعًا
tr: Qul Huwa ‘lLāhu Aḥad (1) Allāhu ‘ṣ-Ṣamad (2) Lam yalid wa lam yū lad (3) Wa lam yaku ‘llahū kufuwan aḥad (4)
en: In the name of Allah, The Profoundly Merciful, The Continually Merciful
Say: Allah is One. (1) Allah is Absolute (2) He neither sired, nor was sired (3) And no one could be like Him.(4)
